newsitem.title: USA: Devon Energy production surge helps Q1 net.
newsitem.headline: Devon Energy production surge helps Q1 net.

text.p: Devon Energy Corp said Monday that sharply higher oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids production helped earnings and revenues climb to record levels in the first quarter ended March 31.

The company said net income totaled $25.2 million, or $0.78 a share, compared with $5.6 million, or $0.25, in the same period a year ago. Total revenues reached $87.9 million, versus $16.1 million in the first quarter of 1996, Devon said.

Devon said total production increased 91 percent to 4.96 million barrels of oil equivalent. Much of the production increase stemmed from the acquisition of oil and gas exploration and production assets of Kerr-McGee Corp in a deal that closed December 31, Devon said.
Devon is an independent energy company.
Its shares were up 5/8 Monday at 29-1/4.
